blurb: Strangler Pods and Strangler Blooms grow from the same spots in Fallout 76, and picking a Strangler Bloom can also give you a Swamp Plant. Each spot grows either a Pod or a Bloom.

consumption.note: Strangler Pod is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
